summary: This bill creates a new tax credit for licensed or certified health professionals who provide healthcare services in qualifying facilities, such as those in health professional shortage areas or Department of Veterans Affairs medical facilities, based on the number of hours worked per month.

scores.thoughts: This bill introduces a new tax credit, which reduces government revenue and is functionally equivalent to government spending. The credit aims to incentivize healthcare professionals in underserved areas, representing a new expenditure.
The core of this bill is the creation of a new tax credit for healthcare professionals. This directly reduces the tax burden for eligible individuals, thus lowering overall taxation.
